display.purpose: Hero and page headlines in Funnel Display 600.

mono.purpose: Spline Sans Mono for CLIF field names and technical ids only.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Ink fill CTA; hover shifts to petrol.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--action-primary-bg, #0E1111); color: var(--action-primary-fg, #F5F6F3); padding: 12px 20px; min-height: 48px; border: none; border-radius: 3px; font-family: "Funnel Sans", system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background 120ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--signal-700, #12495E); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus-ring, #0E1111); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Outlined control; hover fills panel gray.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: transparent; color: var(--text-primary, #0E1111); padding: 12px 20px; min-height: 48px; border: 1px solid var(--action-secondary-border, #0E1111); border-radius: 3px; font-family: "Funnel Sans", system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background 120ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--action-secondary-hover, #EAECE7); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus-ring, #0E1111); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Proposed Tag
components.description: Mint fill status for proposed programs.
components.css: .ds-tag-proposed { display: inline-block; background: var(--signal-400, #3A9B78); color: var(--ink-950, #0E1111); border-radius: 2px; padding: 2px 8px; font-family: "Funnel Sans", system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.4; }

components.name: Data Panel
components.description: Signature white figure with mono header row.
components.html:
organization.record

components.css: .ds-data-panel { background: var(--bg-figure, #FFFFFF); border: 1px solid var(--ink-950, #0E1111); border-radius: 6px; overflow: hidden; font-family: "Funnel Sans", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-data-panel__head { font-family: "Spline Sans Mono", ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.02em; padding: 10px 14px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ink-200, #CDD1CA); color: var(--text-primary, #0E1111); } .ds-data-panel__body { padding: 16px 14px; color: var(--text-body, #3D423E); font-size: 15px; }

components.name: Eyebrow
components.description: Petrol section index / page head eyebrow.
components.css: .ds-eyebrow { font-family: "Funnel Sans", system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 13px; letter-spacing: 0.01em; color: var(--link, #12495E); }

narrative.overview: A cool, clinical public face for open ICU data infrastructure: paper-white grounds, near-black ink type, petrol for links and eyebrows, mint reserved for fills and dark-ground actions. The system feels like a carefully typeset research artifact — hairline rules, numbered sections, and a recurring data-panel motif — not a SaaS marketing kit. Source of truth: design/tokens/* (mirrored in src/styles/*). Agents must preserve this incumbent world; do not replace it with generic Impeccable aesthetics.
keyCharacteristics: Ink + petrol + mint only (crimson is logo/Consortium credit, never Foundation UI chrome)
Funnel Display headlines, Funnel Sans UI/body, Spline Sans Mono for technical ids
Hairline lists over cards; square-ish radii; no product shadows; no gradients
DataPanel as the signature motif; illustrative schematics always labeled

rules.name: The Petrol-on-Light Rule
rules.body: Green (--accent / mint) is never text on light grounds; use petrol (--signal-700) for links and eyebrows.

rules.name: The Crimson Ban
rules.body: Consortium crimson (#841839) never appears in Foundation UI. Logo stays one-color ink (light) or white (dark).

rules.name: The Flat Ground Rule
rules.body: No gradients, no photography collages, no decorative glow. Depth comes from panel bands and 1px ink rules.

rules.name: The Mono Sentence Rule
rules.body: If a string is a sentence, it is not mono. Mono is sentence case — never all caps.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Never add drop shadows, glow, or layered card elevation to polish the system.

dos: Port and extend tokens from design/tokens/ / src/styles/.
Keep sentence case; label proposed work; credit Consortium research.
Use hairline lists and DataPanels instead of card grids.
Respect reduced motion; keep color-only 120ms transitions.
donts: Replace Funnel/Spline with Inter, Roboto, or decorative serifs.
Introduce purple gradients, cream AI beige, glassmorphism, glow, or emoji.
Use mint as body/link text on light grounds.
Put Consortium crimson in Foundation chrome.
Add shadcn/card clutter, stat strips, or hero badge overlays.
